entities.name: Takara
entities.description: Daughter whose sword struck down her father; later serves Volrath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Tyrant of Rath, a shapeshifter who torments and commands others.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin who ponders danger versus boredom in a hidey-hole.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: Oracle of the Vec who speaks of duty, honor guard and the people.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Hero who defeats Volrath's shapeshifter decoy and vows to fight Volrath.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Shapeshifter whose dead form melted from Volrath's features.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: Volrath's former servant, taught by Volrath and warning of plants.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem seeking the Legacy.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Lord of Leaves who speaks of nature and war.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Cat warrior who leaps and keeps watch.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Man who kills Selenia, gripped by the curse, and rages.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Angel shattered by Crovax's blade.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Minotaur wounded by Volrath's torment.

entities.name: Hans
entities.description: Speaker of 'Not again.'

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Speaker who says true heartstones are hard to find.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian master whose vision the Stronghold architect serves.

entities.name: Stronghold architect
entities.description: Writer of journal praising Yawgmoth and designing the Stronghold.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world Gerrard recognizes on the globe.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Artificial plane ruled by Volrath.

entities.name: Volrath's Stronghold
entities.description: The seed of a world's evil.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Reclusive people whose twins train as lancers.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: Pieces Karn needs to be made whole.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: Queen of the slivers, whose children are part of her.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: Shadow-dwelling people feared in tales.

events.summary: Takara is shaken by guilt, knowing the last thing her father saw was her sword.
events.quote: She knew the last image her father had seen was her sword flashing toward him.

events.summary: Gerrard unmasks the dead shapeshifter Vuel who had worn Volrath's features and calls it practice.
events.quote: I'll count this one as practice.

events.summary: Gerrard tells Volrath he now gets to die.
events.quote: Now you get to die.

events.summary: Volrath tells Starke he taught him much yet learned little.
events.quote: you taught me so much yet learned so little.

events.summary: Gerrard hesitates, looking up at the enemy ship, and the future changes.
events.quote: Gerrard hesitated, looking up at the enemy ship.

events.summary: Mirri is startled by Volrath's scentless apparition.
events.quote: Mirri was startled by Volrath's apparition

events.summary: Mirri leaps silently and a guard dies.
events.quote: Mirri leapt quickly and silently.

events.summary: Karn vows never again to let the Legacy slip away.
events.quote: Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again.

events.summary: Gerrard comments on the bottomless pit.
events.quote: I'm sure it came with the place.

events.summary: Selenia freezes and Crovax's blade kills her, fulfilling the curse.
events.quote: Crovax's blade found home.

events.summary: Gerrard tells Crovax he will tire before his pain does.
events.quote: you will tire before it does.

events.summary: Tahngarth declares Volrath has killed him, leaving only the scar.
events.quote: Volrath has killed me.

events.summary: Crovax's rage reduces the shapeshifter to blood and shreds of flesh.
events.quote: Crovax's rage was horrifying.

events.summary: Starke cries out to Takara but she obeys Volrath.
events.quote: It was no use—she obeyed Volrath.

events.summary: Gerrard studies the globe and realizes it shows Dominaria.
events.quote: This is Dominaria!

events.summary: Elves and Vec soldiers charge up the mountain despite being outnumbered.
events.quote: countless elves and Vec soldiers charged up the mountain.

events.summary: Eladamri says Volrath shaped the Skyshroud troopers to war.
events.quote: Volrath shaped us to it.

events.summary: Starke warns of Volrath's hungry plants.
events.quote: These plants aren't nice when they're hungry.

events.summary: Karn explains to the sliver queen that he needs the Legacy to be whole.
events.quote: so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole.

events.summary: Gerrard did not expect a fight from the building itself.
events.quote: I expected a fight, but I didn't expect it from the building itself.

events.summary: Volrath says Rath grows and he is nourished.
events.quote: Rath grows, and I am nourished.

relations.note: Gerrard tells Volrath he gets to die.
Eladamri says Volrath shaped his people for war.
Karn seeks the Legacy pieces to be whole.
relations.quote: I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole

rejected.summary: Eladamri rallies his people to charge.
